rationale: The agent verified the user via email before accessing or modifying account/order data. It retrieved the user’s recent orders, identified the delivered order containing the earbuds, and confirmed the exact item to exchange. The agent then presented available black variants and explicitly asked the user to choose one, stating it would proceed upon confirmation. After the user confirmed the non-water-resistant black option, the agent executed the exchange via the appropriate tool for a delivered order. The tool response shows the exchange was requested, with the correct price difference (+$16.85) matching the new item’s higher price, and the agent accurately communicated that charge and next steps. No unsupported or fabricated information about the order or products was given, and actions were performed on the authenticated user’s own order. While the agent didn’t re-confirm the price difference before executing, it did obtain explicit confirmation of the exact exchange item and then provided accurate final details, which meets the policy’s pass bar.
